nodes.name: SMS Webhook
nodes.notes: Twilio messaging webhook. STOP, HELP, and START are handled here. Owner commands are accepted only from the tenant owner phone.

nodes.name: Load SMS Context
nodes.notes: Tenant, conversation, suppression, open estimate, and rate-limit counts.

nodes.name: Decide SMS
nodes.notes: Qualification, compliance keywords, and owner commands.

nodes.name: Save SMS
nodes.notes: Unknown numbers get an empty 200 so Twilio does not retry.

nodes.name: Apply SMS
nodes.notes: Persists the reply, opt-out, estimate command, and outbound log.

nodes.name: Prepare SMS Response
nodes.notes: TwiML Message nouns send the reply and the owner alert.

nodes.name: Post SMS Alert
nodes.notes: Same OWNER_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL fan-out as the voice workflow.
